name: 4-bit Adder and Hex Counter
description:
Two small DE1-SoC exercises.
adder4 adds two 4-bit numbers into a 5-bit sum (bit 4 is the carry out); its self-checking testbench runs without the board.
counterHex is a board design: KEY0 counts up, KEY1 resets, and the 8-bit count is shown on LEDR[7:0] and in hex on HEX1-HEX0.

files.name: adder4.vhd
files.description: Design: 4-bit unsigned adder, sum = a + b as 5 bits (bit 4 is the carry out). No board ports.

files.name: adder4_tb.vhdl
files.description: Self-checking testbench for adder4: tries all 256 input pairs, reports wrong sums and prints PASS or FAIL. Runs without the board.

files.name: counterHex.vhdl
files.description: Board design: 8-bit counter, KEY0 counts up and KEY1 resets; the count is shown on LEDR[7:0] and in hex on HEX1-HEX0 (HEX2-HEX5 off).
